src: BUILD_PLAN §3.19 (brief v2 §15 street lighting). One row of lamps per street, alternating sides block by block, spacingU apart (~105 st), none within minGapU (25 st) of another lamp or a utility pole, crossClearU from a crossing kerb (review 2026-11-09). Posts and Skyline heads are baked; the client lights the nearest heads at night.
